One fix to my earlier idea: a painting can't be part of a door, because it pops off the wall when the block behind it moves. A **bookshelf door** works better, since pistons can push bookshelves just fine.

2. Next to the doorway, inside the wall, place two **sticky pistons** stacked on top of each other, both facing the doorway.
